Package httyd.model.dragon

Class OwnedDragon

java.lang.Object
httyd.model.dragon.OwnedDragon
public final class OwnedDragon extends Object
A dragon that belongs to the player: one species plus its own rolled stats (IV), nature, star level and Alpha flag. It is the persistent part; the temporary battle state lives in httyd.battle.Combatant.

    • OwnedDragon

      public OwnedDragon(int id, DragonSpecies species, int ivHp, int ivAtk, int ivDef, int ivSpd, Nature nature, boolean alpha, int star)
      Creates an owned dragon.
      Parameters:
      id - unique id within the collection
      species - the species
      ivHp - HP deviation
      ivAtk - ATK deviation
      ivDef - DEF deviation
      ivSpd - SPD deviation
      nature - the nature
      alpha - true for an Alpha dragon
      star - star level from 1 to GameRules.MAX_STAR
